K1.stone_why: Moderate faceting on bowls (O, 6, 0, B) gives a hint of hewn edges, but at a glance it still reads mostly as a smooth book serif.
K1.carving_why: Facets are applied consistently across letters and digits with clean straight cuts, and 1/7, 3/8, 0/O stay clearly distinct.
K1.calm_why: Quiet and steady with full presence; the cuts never call attention to themselves.

K2.stone_why: Clearly polygonal bowls on O, 6, 5, e and s read as chisel-cut planes, giving the titles and set numbers a convincing inscribed feel.
K2.carving_why: One coherent faceting system across caps, lowercase and digits with crisp cuts; only some small bowls (s, e at the largest size) get slightly lumpy, and digits stay legible.
K2.calm_why: Still composed, though the visible angularity adds a little more edge than the softer variants.

K3.stone_why: Faceting is so faint it is barely noticeable even at the largest size, so it reads as an ordinary serif.
K3.carving_why: What carving there is is coherent and clean, but it is too subtle to register at display size.
K3.calm_why: Very calm and balanced with solid presence.

K4.stone_why: Strong faceting on bowls and digits reads as cut stone, comparable to the most carved variants.
K4.carving_why: Facets are mostly coherent, but the rotated-diamond period and slightly uneven segment lengths on 6 and 5 feel more mechanical than chiselled.
K4.calm_why: Steady overall, though the diamond dots and harder corners add a touch of nervousness.

K5.stone_why: Pronounced, even polygonal cuts on O, 0, 6, 5 and the lowercase bowls give a clear hewn-inscription feel.
K5.carving_why: Faceting is consistent across the whole set with crisp planes and a round-ish period, and confusable digits remain easy to separate.
K5.calm_why: Grounded and composed with presence, slightly more insistent than the subtler variants.

K6.stone_why: A smooth, sturdy classical serif with some inscriptional dignity in the caps but no hewn quality.
K6.carving_why: No visible carving; all curves are smooth.
K6.calm_why: Calm, even and authoritative without shouting.
